text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This year's Arima Kinen is almost upon
us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In preparation, I've been staying up late
every
night fine-tuning training routines
and
formulating race strategies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rrruuumble!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Brum-brum-brum-brum!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CRRRASH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the still night air is torn apart
by
deafening crashes and bangs!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What the heck is going on?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, keep it down! You want me to get
busted or
something?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Just a little breaking and entering. Had
to use a
file, drill, and a chainsaw to get
through the wall,
but I did it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I might've irreversibly broken a thing or
two along
the way, but hey, it's nothing
to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What has she done to my wall?
...Actually, I don't
want to know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
FYI, it's your fault for not having a
chimney I
could shimmy down. You
could afford to reel in
that shocked
attitude of yours too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What're you so scared about, anyway?
You
should be over the moon that
someone as lovely
as me is paying you a
clandestine visit, armed
with a bunch of
cool tools.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeesh, people nowadays have such weak
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Here, gifts from Santa Golshi. Toughen
up a bit,
will ya?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She plops something heavy into my
hands.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
High-quality steel, perfect for making
weaponry.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I know you've been feeling weak, but
that'll all
change once you steelify your
body with swords
and armor.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm off. Happy holidays.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure how to take this turn of
events, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still can't get over the chainsaw
massacre that
happened to my wall...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're just living the life, huh? So many
people
would weep in envy if they found
out you got
such a gorgeous gift.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I really don't think anyone would weep
over the
hunk of metal I got. At least not
in envy...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But enough of that. Who lives above
you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Eh, I was just wondering if anyone lives
above
you. If someone does, we miiight
have a problem.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Like, if they don't get out of the way
when I drill
the hole in the ceiling for
this fir tree, they're
gonna be collateral
damage.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Just a lil' decorating. I brought a massive
fir tree
with me, but it's so tall I'll need
to make some
space for it through the
ceiling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tree Gold Ship brought is over thirty
meters
tall...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I politely decline putting it up in my
room and
donate it to the academy for
an outdoor holiday
event instead.
